item.title: AWS Skill Builder Lab - Explore Foundation Models and Prompt Engineering
item.author: admin@andrewrgoss.com (Andrew Goss)
item.description: Description This lab provides hands-on experience to LLMs, testing models with prompts, adjusting model parameters and exploring within the Amazon Bedrock platform. Objectives Access and explore the Amazon Bedrock model offerings. Enable access to LLMs in Amazon Bedrock. Access text and chat playgrounds and experiment with response generation using basic prompts. Experiment with changing model parameters to see how model output is affected. Compare model outputs. AWS Services Amazon Bedrock
